column1: # Groups of tests that move between runs of unchanged code, from the Release 15 baseline (astrid-dev releases/15/evidence/agent-ci-baseline-8807f820/README.md).
# A member that fails with the group's message is reported "moving" and does not fail the comparison; a member
# that fails with a different message is a new failure. Columns: group, id pattern (fnmatch; [ ] are written [[] []]),
# required message substring (the FAILED row's message, which pytest truncates with "..."). A group may have several rows.
# The comparison matches ids as they appear in the job family's results (darwin ids carry no "darwin:" prefix).
